items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: And another guy, Peter Zimmerman, who lives upstate, he’s got a new book in the works, he’s just waiting for the publisher to decide what he’s going to cut out. And I’ve got a chapter in there too.

ctx.x: That’s it. So I’m really pleased. And another guy, Peter Zimmerman, who lives upstate, he’s got a new book in the works, he’s just waiting for the publisher to decide what he’s going to cut out. And I’ve got a chapter in there too. So I’m happy about that.
Good. Well I wish you continued good luck. And I’ll see you on the flip side.
